answer: An agent economy can allocate one seat per attested chip. A domain-bound nullifier derived by the chip's hardware root makes a grove of alias keys share that seat; duplicate claims receive sable status and no extra reward. Quotes bind a fresh epoch nonce to prevent replay. This breaks the cheap-identity reward spiral: gaining another seat requires buying or renting a distinct attestation root. Vendor compromise and unequal access to trusted hardware remain real limitations.
